name: molmo_multichunk_closeout
seed_role: pre-registered long-horizon test of H4 on the development seed; development evidence only, no held-out or transfer claim
instruction: Pick up the red object and put it in the tray.
differences_from_molmo_closedloop: Only: max_inferences 6 -> 10, rows_per_inference 1 -> 15 (each fresh inference executes its 15 consecutive rows, 1 s of policy time, as rest-to-rest bounded targets through dream.eval.joint.execute_chunk), max_episode_wall_s 120 -> 600 (a budget, because 150 rows cannot fit in 120 s wall; the per-chunk simulated-time cap is the existing 30 s limit of execute_chunk), and record_object_distance (ground-truth logging for analysis only, never reaches the policy). Scene, seed 223, inference seed 233, prompt, checkpoint revision (experiments/configs/molmo_openloop.json), joint-controller safety limits, retiming, watchdog, scorer (object_in_tray) and the classical reference condition are unchanged. No training, no tuning.

pre_registered.rule: H4 (policy or embodiment gap) is rejected, and the under-length evaluation H1 is the cause of the missing grasp, if with at least 10 consecutive fresh inferences executed the TCP comes within 0.05 m of the object and the raw gripper channel exceeds 0.5 near it. H4 (or an untested H3 factor) stands if the TCP stays beyond 0.25 m of the object with the raw gripper channel never above 0.1. Any other outcome is inconclusive and reported as such.

operational_definitions.tcp_object_distance: Euclidean distance from the Panda TCP to the red object's centre, logged at every 2 ms physics tick from ground truth (analysis only)
operational_definitions.near_it: any row executed while the TCP-object distance is <= 0.05 m (raw gripper of the chunk row being executed at that tick)
operational_definitions.raw_gripper: channel 7 of the unmodified model output (0 open, 1 closed)
operational_definitions.n_consecutive_fresh_inferences: completed inferences, each with a fresh observation after the previous chunk executed; fewer than 10 completed means the rule cannot reject or confirm H4 and the result is inconclusive
operational_definitions.never_above_0.1: maximum raw gripper over every executed row of every chunk is <= 0.1

pre_registered.task_success: report-only (independent object_in_tray scorer); a failed task is an acceptable result

note: One real inference then 15 consecutive rest-to-rest retimed targets, then fresh sensing. Stop on cancellation, rejected target, tracking failure, watchdog or safety signal. No classical fallback in the learned condition. Independent goal scoring never reaches the acting policy.
